Name: TV Forecast Rain Replacer
Author: RainChicken
Description:
[b]Added i18n support with the current translations ~ French (Loni4ever), German ( [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/xyariaa]xyariaa[/url]), Brazilian Portuguese (@diana_acnh), Polish (Snufkin). Looking for Spanish, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Standard Portuguese, Russian, Turkish or Simplified Chinese![/b]

[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/cF4DUdD.png[/img]
TV Forecast Rain Replacer[/b] is simple mod that makes the TV presenter more enthusiastic whenever there's upcoming rainy days. Sunny days always get the most excitement, but rainy days bring many positive benefits such as not having to water your crops! For those who also love rain, this is for you! A small but meaningful tweak to brighten your rainy days!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/98mOwq8.png[/img]

1. Make sure you have the latest version of [url=http://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
2. Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
3. Install TV Forecast Rain Replacer.
4. Run Stardew Valley using SMAPI.

[b]Manual[/b] - For manual users, extract the folder into your Game/Mod folder.
[b]Mod Manager[/b] - Simply install using your favourite mod manager, [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10455]Stardrop[/url]﻿[/b] or [b]Vortex[/b] and let it handle the rest.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4ZUZ1lT.png[/img]

This mod is fully compliant with Version 1.6. It is such a minor tweak that it shouldn't effect any other mod you have, unless you have a mod that specifically changes the same line of dialogue or TV dialogue overhauls. It simply replaces the in-game rainy day message with this one, it doesn't make rain happen more often.

If you want to revert back, simply uninstall the mod. It won't affect your save mid play and can be removed/re-added at any time.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/PFDC8UA.png[/img]

If you need any help, require support or simply what to join our community, head on over to our [url=https://discord.com/invite/7yZA5pjPuA]discord[/url].
